purpose: P(category | apply) baselines for Bayesian update denominators per V2 design Section 4
sources: Various industry reports (Ivy Coach, BestColleges, IHEP)

totalFirstYearApplicants_2024_25.source: Common App End-of-Season Report 2024-25 — 10.2M apps, est ~1.5M unique applicants

hookPrevalenceInApplicantPool.comment: P(category | apply) — estimates used as denominators in Bayesian update at selective schools

legacy.note: Estimated baseline at non-selective schools. At highly selective, applicants pool has higher legacy concentration

recruitedAthlete.note: Recruited athletes filtered upstream; in general applicant pool quite rare

firstGen.source: Common App reports first-gen ~20% of applicants

international.note: Common App: ~13% of applicants international, varies by school selectivity

nationalLevelAward.note: Estimate — Common App's data shows leadership/award reporting disparities; assumed national+ ~8% of selective school applicants
